Cluster bootstrap for pooled metrics and paired differences

tl_bootstrap.Rd

Resamples subjects (not seconds, windows, beats or episodes) with replacement and recomputes pooled metrics from the per-record contributions. All detectors share the same resampled subjects, so differences between detectors are paired. Replicates whose denominator is zero are undefined; they are counted and left out of the percentile interval.

Usage

tl_bootstrap(contributions, metrics, B = 2000, conf = 0.95,
  summary = c("pooled", "record_mean"), seed = NULL)

Arguments

contributions

Output of tl_contributions(), possibly row-bound across several ledgers that share subjects.

metrics

Metric names from tl_metrics() whose numerator and denominator are both additive (all ratio metrics are).

B

Number of bootstrap replicates.

conf

Confidence level of the percentile interval.

summary

"pooled" (ratio of resampled sums) or "record_mean" (mean of per-record ratios over the resampled records).

seed

Optional random seed.

Value

A data frame with one row per detector (and per difference between the first detector and each other one) and metric: estimate, lower, upper, B, n_undefined, n_subjects.

Examples

fx <- tl_fixture("two_detectors")
led <- tl_ledger(fx$records, fx$reference, fx$predictions,
                 time_unit = "min")
cb <- tl_contributions(led, tl_match(led))
tl_bootstrap(cb, c("full_capture", "answer_coverage"), B = 200, seed = 1)
#>   detector          metric   estimate      lower      upper   B n_undefined
#> 1        A    full_capture  0.7555556  0.7555556  0.7555556 200           0
#> 2        B    full_capture  0.4666667  0.4666667  0.4666667 200           0
#> 3    B - A    full_capture -0.2888889 -0.2888889 -0.2888889 200           0
#> 4        A answer_coverage  1.0000000  1.0000000  1.0000000 200           0
#> 5        B answer_coverage  0.7000000  0.7000000  0.7000000 200           0
#> 6    B - A answer_coverage -0.3000000 -0.3000000 -0.3000000 200           0
#>   n_subjects
#> 1          1
#> 2          1
#> 3          1
#> 4          1
#> 5          1
#> 6          1
